mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates below 0.2% signal accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 5.0% indicate economic weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in nonfarm payroll employment signal deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a rolling 12-month regression.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 235.0 indicates persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts above 1000.0 indicate robust consumer demand for housing, boosting construction sector activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1000.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105.0 signals strong manufacturing activity, improving corporate profit outlooks and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates broad-based consumer demand, strengthening corporate revenue expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rates above 0.25% signal monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.25%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.
